aboutSection.heading: The first edition, in Patna
aboutSection.intro: Chapter 1 of the Bihar Setu Tourism Summit gets the whole tourism chain into one hall, so roads, rooms, food and stories are ready before the promotion begins.
aboutSection.point1Text: Officials and district teams hear directly from the people who run hotels and tours.
aboutSection.point2Text: Panels look at what visitors will find on arrival, not only at how to attract them.
aboutSection.point3Title: Food is part of the story.
aboutSection.point3Text: A 114 dish pavilion puts Bihar's cooking next to its heritage.
aboutSection.point4Text: Investor and district meetings are built into both days.

aboutPage.platformIntro: A bridge between Bihar's potential and its future, Bihar Setu is a multi-sector development and collaboration platform created to connect ideas, institutions, professionals, communities and citizens.
aboutPage.visionHeading: A connected, collaborative and opportunity-driven Bihar
aboutPage.visionIntro: Empowering every citizen. Connecting every district. Our vision is to become a trusted multi-sector platform that connects people, institutions, industries and ideas for the inclusive and sustainable development of Bihar.
aboutPage.pillar1Desc: Addressing systemic and regional challenges through dialogue, partnerships and joint action.
aboutPage.pillar2Desc: Giving visibility and growth to local crafts, district enterprises, culture, heritage and grassroots innovations.
aboutPage.pillar3Desc: Opening pathways to mentorship, skill-building, venture creation and career progression.
aboutPage.pillar4Desc: Making sure every development initiative has socio-economic dividends across decades.
aboutPage.quote: "Bihar Setu is where connections begin and collective progress becomes possible."
aboutPage.transformSubtitle: Structured pathways that connect foundational challenges to actionable development outcomes.
aboutPage.dim1Desc: Connecting empowerment, welfare and public services with social outcomes and career opportunities.
aboutPage.dim2Desc: Link district enterprises, traditional services, artisans and producers to regional, national and global markets.
aboutPage.dim3Desc: Collaborative dialogue, policy alignment and partnerships for statewide industrial growth.
aboutPage.dim4Desc: Connecting grassroot innovators and founders with incubators, mentors, capital and financial institutions.
aboutPage.dim5Desc: Modern vocational skills, digital readiness, mentorship and career avenues for Bihar's youth.
aboutPage.dim6Desc: Reimagining local MSMEs and traditional artisans for established supply chains and trade networks.
aboutPage.impactDesc: Bihar Setu follows a 5-stage structured pipeline so ideas move beyond discussion into practical, collaborative and tracked execution initiatives, with 100% clear accountability across all 38 districts.

agendaPage.timingNote: 10:45 AM – 4:45 PM · Four 60-minute panels each day. Speaker names and timings are subject to confirmation.
